mic.note: ICS-43434 I2S MEMS mic (bottom port: port hole through the board) facing the front grille chamber; foam gasket ring between board and grille

status_led.note: green 0603 LED under the front light pipe (pipe ends 1.4 above the board); the pipe's window is the slit beside the grille

button.note: 6 x 6 x 5.0 tact switch (XKB 1TS009, plunger top 5.0 above the top face) under the Ø12 top cap: tap = "I'm awake" (stops the watch buzzing), hold 3 s = test / pair

usb.note: GCT USB4105 USB-C 16P top-mount (footprint centre), mouth flush with the +x board edge (x 26), centre 1.6 above the top face. Main power input (plugged in) and charges the 103450 cell

module.note: ESP32-C6-MINI-1 footprint origin (body x -20.05..-6.85, y -5..11.6, 2.4 tall), antenna end at the +y edge

power_switch.note: C&K PCM12SMTR right-angle SMD SPDT slide (footprint origin; body x 21.55..24.15, y 3.15..9.85, 1.5 tall). Lever 1.3 wide x 1.55 long, centre ~0.8 above the top face, tip 0.3 inside the +x board edge (x 25.7), slides along y (travel ~1.5 mm, centre at y 6.5): the back wall needs a slider cap that engages the lever

cell.note: off-board: 103450 LiPo (10 x 34 x 50, ~2000 mAh) on the bottom plate, 1.0 below the bottom face

glow_led.note: WS2812B-2020 under the 20 x 20 frosted lens: intensity colour + wake pulse

link_led.note: green 0603 LED under the Ø1.6 link light pipe at 6 o'clock (pipe ends 1.4 above the board: KiCad's 0603 LED model is 1.1 tall)

lra.note: off-board: Ø10 x 2.7 ERM coin motor glued to the back plate (skin side), top 2.6 below the bottom face, 2 wires to pads (MOSFET drive)

battery.note: off-board: 402025 LiPo (~150 mAh) on the back plate, 1.0 below the bottom face; bottom-face parts <= 1.0 tall over it

module.note: ESP32-C6-MINI-1 footprint origin (body x -6.2..7, y -2..14.6, 2.4 tall), antenna end at the +y edge

pogo_pos.note: spring pogo pin (bottom face, ~5 mm) pressing on a gold contact moulded into the back plate; the magnetic USB charger clips onto the back

pogo_neg.note: second pogo pin; two Ø3 x 1 magnets in the back plate at board (-1, -13) and (13, -13) align the charger
